name: Kanojo wa Maid Rot ~Yuukyuu no Sayokyoku~
original_name: 彼女はメイドRot ～悠久の小夜曲～
source:
Main character moves to an old castle after receiving a mysterious letter. From here starts his story about relations with three maids of the castle.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角收到一封神秘信件後，搬進了一座古老城堡。從這裡開始，他與城堡中三名女僕之間的故事。

［譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]］
